messages:
elaine: Heads-up — PR #3412 is ready for docs review. I added the new SDK snippet for the streaming responses but the preview doesn't show the updated example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3412

samir: I checked the deploy preview briefly — page loads but the snippet looks like the old version. Could be cached assets (CSS/JS). Netlify sometimes serves stale hashed assets when the manifest isn't updated.

marta: Common workaround: trigger a cache purge on Netlify or open the preview with a cache-busting query param. Also: ensure the build actually wrote new asset hashes.

elaine: Can someone trigger a purge? I don't have Netlify access for the org site. If we can't purge, I'll include a short note in the PR for reviewers to open the preview with `?preview=ts` as a quick check.

docs-ci: Preview build finished for branch `feature/docs-sdk-streaming` (PR #3412). Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-3412--docs.redwood.ai
Build summary:
```\nCopying assets... 5 files copied\nManifest hash: abc123\nGenerated: 2025-11-09T14:12:20Z\n```
It looks like the manifest hash matches the last commit in this branch. If the page is stale, it's likely a browser cache issue.

samir: If the CI build shows the new manifest but the browser still shows old content, try a hard reload or `?preview=1` param. For local checks: `pip install -r docs/requirements.txt && mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000` then open `http://localhost:8000`.

toni: FYI the docs linkcheck job flaked once on `linkcheck (staging)`. I'm going to re-run it; not a blocker for review unless it fails consistently.

marta: I can request a Netlify cache purge — doing it now and will post when complete.

deploy-bot: Netlify cache purge requested by marta — job id purge_8271.

deploy-bot: Netlify cache purge complete (purge_8271).

elaine: Re-opened the preview with `?preview=1` and the snippet shows the streaming example now. Thanks! Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-3412--docs.redwood.ai/?preview=1

marta: Great. For approvals: please get one from `docs-a11y` (quick accessibility pass) and one from `api-owner` (Samir or Toni). I can LGTM after those are in.

toni: I'm available for the API review; I'll take a look at the snippet to confirm the example matches runtime behavior. I can merge at 15:00 PT if all checks green.

samir: quick note — linkcheck rerun started. If it passes, we should be fine.

docs-ci: Re-run triggered for `linkcheck (staging)` (build 3412.2).

docs-ci: All CI checks green. Preview updated: https://deploy-preview-3412--docs.redwood.ai/?preview=1

elaine: Thanks everyone — merging in 10m after clock sync. If anything looks off post-merge I'll open a hotfix PR. :rocket:
